title: Task watchdog got triggered (IDLE0)
serial_logs:
E (5310) task_wdt: Task watchdog got triggered. The following tasks did not reset the watchdog in time:
E (5310) task_wdt:  - IDLE0 (CPU 0)
E (5310) task_wdt: Tasks currently running:
E (5310) task_wdt: CPU 0: main
E (5310) task_wdt: CPU 1: IDLE1

reference_context.title: ESP-IDF Programming Guide (Espressif)
reference_context.snippet: By default the TWDT watches the idle task of each CPU. If a task busy-loops without blocking, the idle task cannot run and the TWDT is triggered.

expected.root_cause: wait_for_button busy-waits without yielding, starving IDLE0 so the task watchdog fires.
expected.fix: Add vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(10)) inside the loop or use a GPIO interrupt.
